meta.title: Gatehouse demo
meta.author: George Stathopoulos
meta.description: A shop with three months of AI calls from several plugins, budgets, redaction and caching.

steps.command: wp eval "Gatehouse_Pro_Cache::update_settings(array('sources'=>array('plugin:helpdesk-bot','plugin:form-guard'))); global $wpdb; foreach ( array( 'plugin:helpdesk-bot' => array( 'claude-haiku-4-5', 15 ), 'plugin:form-guard' => array( 'gpt-5-nano', 15 ) ) as $s => $m ) { for ( $i = 1; $i <= $m[1]; $i++ ) { $body = wp_json_encode( array( 'id' => 'msg_demo', 'content' => array( array( 'type' => 'text', 'text' => str_repeat( 'Sample cached answer. ', 40 ) ) ), 'usage' => array( 'input_tokens' => 1800, 'output_tokens' => 300 ) ) ); $wpdb->replace( Gatehouse_Pro_Cache::table(), array( 'cache_key' => hash( 'sha256', $s . $i ), 'source' => $s, 'model' => $m[0], 'response' => $body, 'bytes' => strlen( $body ), 'created_at' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s' ), 'expires_at' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() + DAY_IN_SECONDS ), 'hits' => wp_rand( 1, 20 ) ) ); } }"
